static_traits.name: Chen Bowen
static_traits.family_status: No immediate family members, living alone
static_traits.social_status: Limited social interaction, no intimate relationships outside work; weak Social support, but can talk with a few colleagues
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no prior counseling or psychiatric treatment history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic, able to self-reflect; highly cooperative, positive attitude, calm tone mixed with stress and Self-doubt

basic_info.main_problem: Although the factory salary is decent, feeling unproductive I began questioning my worth and the reason for taking this pay. These thoughts persisted over recent months and recently intensified; triggered by management setting new productivity targets, affecting my daily motivation and self-esteem, with declining work performance, especially obvious when facing high-productivity-demand tasks.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts about self-worth and productivity are affecting my work performance and overall health.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on work output
I do not deserve this salary

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot meet these targets, it means I am incompetent and worthless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Setting daily goals, consulting colleagues, trying to compensate for insufficiency with harder work

special_situations.event: Is assigned tasks directly tied to new productivity indicators
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any error on these tasks proves I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps setting small goals and asking colleagues for advice, while self-reproaching to improve performance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am failing, I am not suited for this job

special_situations.event: Thinking 'salary does not match my output'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only if the output fully matches the salary do I count as worth being paid
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplays or ignores existing positive feedback and achievements, demanding self by stricter standards
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I do not deserve this pay

special_situations.event: Days when occasionally completing tasks and feeling some achievement
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot stably meet targets long-term, these small successes do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplays the day's achievements, continues to focus on gaps and big goals
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time was just luck; failure will come again

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized through work, to prove he is worthy
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being seen as incompetent, undeserving of pay, thus being negated and humiliated
defense_goal: Controlling Anxiety and maintaining worth through self-demands and doubled effort
Keeps a certain distance from people to reduce evaluation and exposure from others

object_relations.object_representation: A demanding manager/other who judges people by numbers

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes the few success experiences and invites seeing the positive side
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to think these successes do not represent overall performance, others' affirmation 'not real enough/does not count'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Restrained tone, using words like 'but/just luck' to downplay the positive, quickly shifting to insufficiency and gaps.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the relation between new productivity goals and self-worth
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating not yet meeting targets with 'I am not good enough', internalizing external standards as self-negation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming phrasing, lowering self-evaluation, avoiding expressing dissatisfaction with external standards.

manifestations: Equates self-worth with productivity and performance
Believing oneself undeserving of the salary
Strong Self-doubt when not yet meeting targets
No immediate family members, living alone
Limited social interaction, no intimate relationships outside work
outcomes: More prone to negative thinking when lacking emotional support

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Takes the productivity goals set by management as the sole standard for measuring self-worth
Using self-demands of 'must meet targets to be valuable'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-blame 'I am not good enough'
Excessively scrutinizes oneself by the goal gap, ignoring existing achievements and resources

exception_events.target_problem: When assigned tasks directly tied to new productivity targets, the client usually develops strong pressure and Self-doubt, scattered focus, decreased productivity and feeling undeserving of the salary.
exception_events.unique_outcome: On individual days, the client did not indulge in 'too far from targets' thoughts as usual, but focused on 'doing one task well at a time', completing the day's tasks fairly engaged, feeling slight achievement.
exception_events.reason: Clues: better mood that day, lower pressure; different approach: shifting attention from overall metrics to current tasks, thus lightening burden and improving focus.

positive_force: Has willingness to seek help and actively participates in counseling; attitude is positive
Can proactively try strategies (setting daily goals, asking colleagues for advice)
Has self-awareness and can summarize effective methods (focusing on the current task)
Work relatively stable with good pay, has external resources
negative_force: A cognition that rigidly binds self-worth to work output
Personalization and black-and-white thinking increase stress
Weak social support, long-term living alone and limited socializing
Self-care declines; diet and daily habits are affected

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecation and decreased motivation in work situations
antecedent: Being assigned tasks directly tied to metrics
Thinking salary does not match one's output
target_behavior.core_reason: Equating self-worth with productivity and external metrics, with black-and-white and negating-the-positive cognitive patterns
target_behavior.function: Short-term avoidance of failure and shame, reducing immediate stress by lowering engagement
target_behavior.consequence: Declining work performance, impaired self-esteem, increased stress, worsening self-care and diet habits
